title: Rewind catalog clearing configuration
statement: Let $i$ be one of the $k$ work tapes, let $d$ be a configuration with a sweep phase, and let $n$ and $r$ be natural numbers. Define a configuration in the rewind phase by clearing tape $i$ on the integer interval from $d$'s head position on that tape plus $r$ (inclusive) to that position plus $n$ (exclusive). Move that tape's head by $r-1$ positions, and retain the other fields and all other tape contents and head positions.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index among the $k$ work tapes
$d$ is a configuration with a sweep phase
